```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source(here::here("scripts/R/functions/report_setup.R"))
setup_report(
  sources = c("02", "03"),
  funs = c("assoc_tests"),
  packages = c("here", "dplyr", "knitr", "kableExtra", "dagitty", "survival",
               "coxphf", "logistf", "coin"),
  set_theme = FALSE
)

data$sex_num <- as.numeric(as.character(data$sex))
data$T_num   <- as.numeric(data$Rx == "Experimental arm")
data$TxTMB   <- data$T_num * data$tmb_braf
data$tmb_braf_fac <- factor(data$tmb_braf)
data$TxTMB_fac    <- factor(data$TxTMB)
data$T_fac    <- factor(data$T_num)
data$sex_fac  <- factor(data$sex_num)
data$crp_fac  <- factor(data$crp)

data_tlr  <- data[!is.na(data$tlr), ]
data_main <- data[complete.cases(data[, c("Age", "sex", "Rx", "crp", "tmb_braf",
                                          "T_num", "TxTMB", "OSwk", "Death",
                                          "PFSwk", "Progression")]), ]
```

```{r helpers, include=FALSE}
# Association-test helpers are provided by assoc_tests.R.
```

```{r run-tests, include=FALSE}
edge_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  run_wilcox_test(data, "tmb_braf", "Age", "Age -> TMB_BRAF", "Wilcoxon rank-sum",
                  c("TMB/BRAF=0", "TMB/BRAF=1")),
  run_firth_cox_test(data_main, Surv(OSwk, Death) ~ Age, "Age", "Age -> OS", "Firth Cox"),
  run_fisher_test(data, "sex_num", "tmb_braf", "Sex -> TMB_BRAF", "Fisher's exact"),
  run_firth_cox_test(data_main, Surv(PFSwk, Progression) ~ tmb_braf, "tmb_braf",
                     "TMB_BRAF -> PFS", "Firth Cox"),
  run_firth_cox_test(data_main, Surv(OSwk, Death) ~ tmb_braf, "tmb_braf",
                     "TMB_BRAF -> OS", "Firth Cox"),
  run_firth_logistic_test(data_tlr, tlr ~ tmb_braf, "tmb_braf",
                          "TMB_BRAF -> TLR", "Firth logistic"),
  run_firth_cox_test(data_main, Surv(PFSwk, Progression) ~ crp, "crp",
                     "CRP -> PFS", "Firth Cox"),
  run_firth_cox_test(data_main, Surv(OSwk, Death) ~ crp, "crp",
                     "CRP -> OS", "Firth Cox"),
  run_firth_logistic_test(data_tlr, tlr ~ crp, "crp", "CRP -> TLR", "Firth logistic"),
  run_firth_cox_test(data_main, Surv(PFSwk, Progression) ~ T_num, "T_num",
                     "T -> PFS", "Firth Cox"),
  run_firth_cox_test(data_main, Surv(OSwk, Death) ~ T_num, "T_num",
                     "T -> OS", "Firth Cox"),
  run_firth_logistic_test(data_tlr, tlr ~ T_num, "T_num", "T -> TLR", "Firth logistic"),
  run_firth_cox_test(data_tlr, Surv(PFSwk, Progression) ~ tlr, "tlr",
                     "TLR -> PFS", "Firth Cox (TLR subset)"),
  run_firth_cox_test(data_main, Surv(OSwk, Death) ~ PFSwk, "PFSwk",
                     "PFS -> OS", "Firth Cox"),
  run_firth_cox_test(data_main, Surv(PFSwk, Progression) ~ T_num + tmb_braf + T_num:tmb_braf,
                     "T_num:tmb_braf", "TxTMB -> PFS", "Firth Cox interaction"),
  run_firth_cox_test(data_main, Surv(OSwk, Death) ~ T_num + tmb_braf + T_num:tmb_braf,
                     "T_num:tmb_braf", "TxTMB -> OS", "Firth Cox interaction")
) |> mutate(Conclusion = edge_support_label(p_value))

ci_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  run_wilcox_test(data, "crp", "Age", "Age _||_ CRP", "Wilcoxon rank-sum",
                  c("CRP=0", "CRP=1")),
  run_wilcox_test(data, "sex_num", "Age", "Age _||_ Sex", "Wilcoxon rank-sum",
                  c("Sex=0", "Sex=1")),
  run_wilcox_test(data, "T_num", "Age", "Age _||_ T",
                  "Wilcoxon rank-sum (randomization check)", c("T=0", "T=1")),
  run_firth_logistic_test(data_tlr, tlr ~ crp + tmb_braf + Age, "Age",
                          "Age _||_ TLR | {CRP, TMB_BRAF}", "Firth logistic"),
  run_permutation_test(data, Age ~ TxTMB_fac | tmb_braf_fac,
                       "Age _||_ TxTMB | {TMB_BRAF}", "Conditional permutation test",
                       seed = analysis_seed),
  run_fisher_test(data, "crp", "sex_num", "CRP _||_ Sex", "Fisher's exact"),
  run_fisher_test(data, "crp", "T_num", "CRP _||_ T",
                  "Fisher's exact (randomization check)"),
  run_mh_test(data, "crp", "TxTMB", "tmb_braf", "CRP _||_ TxTMB | {TMB_BRAF}",
              "Mantel-Haenszel"),
  run_fisher_test(data, "sex_num", "T_num", "Sex _||_ T",
                  "Fisher's exact (randomization check)"),
  run_mh_test(data, "sex_num", "TxTMB", "tmb_braf", "Sex _||_ TxTMB | {TMB_BRAF}",
              "Mantel-Haenszel"),
  run_firth_logistic_test(data_tlr, tlr ~ crp + tmb_braf + sex_num, "sex_num",
                          "Sex _||_ TLR | {CRP, TMB_BRAF}", "Firth logistic"),
  run_firth_logistic_test(data_tlr, tlr ~ T_num + tmb_braf + TxTMB, "TxTMB",
                          "TLR _||_ TxTMB | {T, TMB_BRAF}", "Firth logistic"),
  run_fisher_test(data, "T_num", "tmb_braf", "T _||_ TMB_BRAF",
                  "Fisher's exact (randomization check)")
) |> mutate(
  Randomization_Check = Item %in% c("Age _||_ T", "CRP _||_ T", "Sex _||_ T", "T _||_ TMB_BRAF"),
  Conclusion = ci_support_label(p_value, Randomization_Check)
)

consolidated_summary_table <- bind_rows(
  edge_results |>
    transmute(Domain = "Direct edge", Item, Effect, `p-value` = fmt_p(p_value), Conclusion),
  ci_results |>
    transmute(Domain = "Conditional independence", Item, Effect,
              `p-value` = fmt_p(p_value), Conclusion)
)
```

```{r display-table}
kable(consolidated_summary_table,
      caption = "Consolidated summary of direct edge and conditional-independence tests",
      format = "html") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = TRUE, font_size = 12) |>
  pack_rows("Direct edges", 1, nrow(edge_results)) |>
  pack_rows("Conditional independence", nrow(edge_results) + 1, nrow(consolidated_summary_table)) |>
  footnote(
    general = c(
      "Data from METIMMOX trial (NCT03388190). Scripts 02 and 03 sourced.",
      "CRP = C-reactive protein; TLR = target lesion reduction; TMB = tumor mutational burden.",
      "Firth-corrected Cox and logistic regression used throughout. Fisher's exact for 2x2 tables.",
      "Randomization balance checks: Age||T, CRP||T, Sex||T, T||TMB_BRAF. No multiplicity correction applied."
    ),
    general_title = "Notes: "
  )
```

```{r save-csv, include=FALSE}
tables_dir <- here("tables")
if (!dir.exists(tables_dir)) dir.create(tables_dir, recursive = TRUE)
write.csv(consolidated_summary_table, file = here("tables", "clin_effect_table_s1.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved to:", here("tables", "clin_effect_table_s1.csv"), "\n")
```

Table saved to `tables/clin_effect_table_s1.csv`.
